#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Serialized native gate for the local three-party continuation.
# Usage: gate.sh core|mathlib MODULE [MODULE...]
#   core    -> python3 scripts/check.py --core-profile ...            (paper16 / Init-Lean-Std closures)
#   mathlib -> python3 scripts/check.py --memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048 ...
# scripts/check.py, its caps, locks and pins are unchanged. This wrapper only
# waits politely when the single compiler lock is busy (exit 75) or the memory
# gate is closed (exit 76), and raises a flag so the background cache warmer yields.
set -u
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"; root="$(cd "$here/../.." && pwd)"
profile="${1:?profile}"; shift
case "$profile" in
  core) flags=(--core-profile) ;;
  mathlib) flags=(--memory-mib 2048 --rss-mib 1536 --min-free-mib 2048) ;;
  *) echo "profile must be core or mathlib" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
flag="$here/logs/gate-waiting.$$"; : > "$flag"; trap 'rm -f "$flag"' EXIT
cd "$root" || exit 2
deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + ${GATE_WAIT_SECONDS:-1500} ))
while :; do
  touch "$flag"
  python3 scripts/check.py "${flags[@]}" "$@"; rc=$?
  if [ "$rc" -ne 75 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 76 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
  if [ "$(date +%s)" -ge "$deadline" ]; then echo "GATE_WAIT_TIMEOUT rc=$rc" >&2; exit "$rc"; fi
  sleep $(( rc == 76 ? 20 : 3 ))
done

# Fable-2 ledger — local round 3 (2026-11-22)

## G04 — type guards

### Plan

Discharge the two retained type-guard conjunctions of #1438/#1440/#1442 at `tv := TV`:
`unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod` and
`unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod`.

What was read (and only this): the three `…Targets.lean` of #1438/#1440/#1442, the #1438 proof,
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall{Definitions,Targets,Proof}.lean`, review findings 1
and 2 of `github-round2-review-2026-11-22/P16-APPLICATION-REVIEW.md`, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` returns, from `addressReport q ctx ty k` and
   `unary Q.scalar (suc z) q`: `unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓ (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
   leastGraph … ctx ty k k))`. At `tv := TV` the two operands therefore supply
   `unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` (from `qf`) and `unary TV (suc z) dom` (from `qa`). So the
   first component of the syntax guard is free; nothing else of the two conjunctions is.
2. `TV` and `T` are universally quantified `Program 1` parameters of `install` with NO calibration
   hypothesis in any of the three statements. `refitGuard s T = conjunction T (grammarTypeAt s)`
   (`NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions.lean:30`), i.e. `T` plus physical membership
   in the finite list `s.types`.
3. Grep for an accepted arrow-inversion law (`ArrowInversion`, `TypeInversion`, `arrowInversion`,
   `typeGood`, `ArrowClosed`, and any target whose conclusion is `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) _`) in
   `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/*Targets.lean`: no match. The only calibrations of type programs
   found (`TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualTypeGuard tv`) are numeric evaluation statements, not
   derivability laws of the internal calculus, and none is a hypothesis of the application statements.
4. Hence branch three of the task: arrow inversion is not available for arbitrary `TV`/`T` (a `TV`
   accepting the single code `rawCons a b` and nothing else is a legitimate `Program 1`), so the guards
   are derived under a NAMED calibration premise and the guard-free statements are proved under exactly
   that premise.

Premise chosen: `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T` — for all `α Γ dom cod`, from derivations of
`unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` and `unary TV (suc z) dom` a derivation of
`unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)`.
Hypotheses = exactly what scalar acceptance supplies; conclusion = exactly what is missing. Two
component laws (`ArrowCodomainInversion body TV`, `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T`) are stated and shown
sufficient, so the premise has a readable decomposition.

Not attempted (budget): whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` already entails the refit guard at `ty`
(the base window is `numberedTypeWindow … T`, which may check `T`); if it does, the refit half at `dom`
would be free and the premise could shrink to codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T`.

### Targets + sha256 (recorded before the proof module was drafted)

`LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets.lean`
sha256 `59d05ab1d9b4bd5d972fb66199122a27e20447cba68a9af4bb19031d1940005d`

Definitions: `ArrowCodomainInversion`, `SyntaxGuardRefits`, `TypeGuardArrowCalibration`.
Statements: `ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents`, `ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress`, `ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.

### Receipts

- `1795402283407171155-3276597` (`build-reports/1795402283407171155-3276597.json`, sha256
  `54f38d0db2b2ea0c9198827838f394b8e6bf2089a6eb18c3e4d413da4851cee8`) — `gate.sh mathlib` on
  `…GuardFreeTargets` and `…GuardFreeProof`: COMPILE_PASS for both. Five `#print axioms` lines, each
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- Proof module sha256 `638cbda693b86d63cf92d63c387c204467be91c4c0f195e4cb2ba750af245ccb`; targets
  sha256 unchanged from the frozen value above.

### Failures

None. One gate run, passed first time. (A plain multi-file read command was refused by the
permission mode early on; files were read with the read tool instead — no effect on the work.)

### State and next

STOPPED AT FIRST GATED STATEMENT. Result is conditional: the guards are discharged under the named
premise `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T`, not unconditionally. Evidence in
`TYPE-GUARDS-EVIDENCE.json`, claims and non-claims in `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

Next, in order:
1. Read `numberedTypeWindow` / `headFittedWindow` to see whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entails
   `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) ty`. If yes, the refit guard at `dom` and at `rawCons dom cod` comes
   free from the operands' windows and the premise shrinks to codomain inversion of `TV` and of
   `refitGuard s T`.
2. Prove `ArrowCodomainInversion` for the actual source type program (the one calibrated by
   `ActualTypeGuard` / `TypeGuardCalibrated`), which needs an internal inversion of that program and
   closure of `s.types` under arrow components (`GrammarTypeInclusion s` is the place to look).

6	namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets
7	open FirstOrder Language
8	open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
9	open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
10	open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
11	open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z eqn)

15	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
16	open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
17	open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
18	open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (addressReport)
19	open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitterObjectTargets (addressTerm)
20	open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)
21	
22	/-- Codomain inversion of one type program at an arrow code, as a rule of the
23	calculus over `body`: acceptance of `rawCons dom cod` yields acceptance of
24	`cod`. This is a property of the supplied program; it is not derivable for an
25	arbitrary `Program 1`. -/
26	def ArrowCodomainInversion (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (TV : Program 1) : Prop :=
27	  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod : OTerm α),
28	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod))) →
29	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) cod))
30	
31	/-- The syntax type program entails the refit guard, as a rule of the calculus
32	over `body`: every type accepted by `TV` is accepted by `refitGuard s T`, that
33	is by `T` and by the physical grammar-type membership of `s`. -/
34	def SyntaxGuardRefits (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1) : Prop :=
35	  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ty : OTerm α),
36	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) ty)) →
37	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) ty))
38	
39	/-- The named calibration premise on the two type programs of an installation
40	with scalar type checker `TV`. Its two hypotheses are exactly the two type
41	facts that installed-scalar acceptance of a function address at
42	`rawCons dom cod` and of an argument address at `dom` supply; its conclusion is
43	exactly the part of the two retained type-guard conjunctions that those facts
44	do not already contain: `TV` at `cod` and the refit guard at `dom` and `cod`.
45	It mentions no address, window, least call, scalar or application program. -/
46	def TypeGuardArrowCalibration (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1) : Prop :=
47	  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod : OTerm α),
48	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod))) →
49	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom)) →
50	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓
51	      (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)))
52	
53	/-- The two component laws are sufficient for the named premise. -/
54	def ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents : Prop :=
55	  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1),
56	    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV → SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T →
57	    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T
58	
59	/-- The two retained type-guard conjunctions of the application statements,
60	derived. For the installation with scalar type checker `TV`, two accepted
61	installed-scalar operand addresses with matching function/argument reports at
62	one context yield both conjunctions under the named calibration premise. No
63	type-guard derivation is a premise. -/
64	def ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards : Prop :=
65	  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
66	    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
67	    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
68	    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α),
69	    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
70	    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T →
71	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
72	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
73	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
74	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
75	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) ∧
76	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
77	      (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod))
78	
79	/-- The accepted output address of an application with no type-guard
80	hypothesis. For the installation with scalar type checker `TV`, under the
81	named calibration premise on `TV` and `T`, two accepted installed-scalar
82	operand addresses with their original reports at one context yield, under the

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputFunctionalityTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z eqn)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseAddressPositiveOpenTargets (addressReport)
open NumberedWindowInternalFreshProbeParsedEmitterObjectTargets (addressTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)

/-- Codomain inversion of one type program at an arrow code, as a rule of the
calculus over `body`: acceptance of `rawCons dom cod` yields acceptance of
`cod`. This is a property of the supplied program; it is not derivable for an
arbitrary `Program 1`. -/
def ArrowCodomainInversion (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (TV : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) cod))

/-- The syntax type program entails the refit guard, as a rule of the calculus
over `body`: every type accepted by `TV` is accepted by `refitGuard s T`, that
is by `T` and by the physical grammar-type membership of `s`. -/
def SyntaxGuardRefits (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ty : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) ty)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) ty))

/-- The named calibration premise on the two type programs of an installation
with scalar type checker `TV`. Its two hypotheses are exactly the two type
facts that installed-scalar acceptance of a function address at
`rawCons dom cod` and of an argument address at `dom` supply; its conclusion is
exactly the part of the two retained type-guard conjunctions that those facts
do not already contain: `TV` at `cod` and the refit guard at `dom` and `cod`.
It mentions no address, window, least call, scalar or application program. -/
def TypeGuardArrowCalibration (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓
      (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)))

/-- The two component laws are sufficient for the named premise. -/
def ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1),
    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV → SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T →
    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T

/-- The two retained type-guard conjunctions of the application statements,
derived. For the installation with scalar type checker `TV`, two accepted
installed-scalar operand addresses with matching function/argument reports at
one context yield both conjunctions under the named calibration premise. No
type-guard derivation is a premise. -/
def ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod))

/-- The accepted output address of an application with no type-guard
hypothesis. For the installation with scalar type checker `TV`, under the
named calibration premise on `TV` and `T`, two accepted installed-scalar
operand addresses with their original reports at one context yield, under the
genuine object continuation, the measured least `m` of the actual auxiliary
term, the original report of `addressTerm ctx cod m`, and its acceptance by
the same installed scalar. -/
def ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- Frontend acceptance of an application with no type-guard hypothesis: the
same premises, and the continuation additionally receives the unit graph of the
actual installed application program on `(qf, qa, addressTerm ctx cod m)`. -/
def ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (programGraph Q.application (suc z)
          ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m])) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- Output functionality of an application with no type-guard hypothesis: the
same premises, and the continuation additionally receives, for every term `y`
of the extended context, the internal implication from acceptance of
`(qf, qa, y)` by the installed application program to
`y = addressTerm ctx cod m`. -/
def ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv TV root other
    TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (programGraph Q.application (suc z)
          ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m])) →
      (∀ y : OTerm β, Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        ((programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,y]).imp
          (eqn y (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputFunctionalityProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationFrontendAcceptanceProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputAddressProof
import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstallProof

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeProof
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z eqn)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall (install)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstallProof (exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputAddressProof
  (exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationFrontendAcceptanceProof
  (exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationFrontendAcceptance)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationOutputFunctionalityProof
  (exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

theorem exact_TypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents :
    ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents := by
  intro body s TV T inversion refits α Γ dom cod arrow domain
  obtain ⟨codomain⟩ := inversion α Γ dom cod arrow
  obtain ⟨refitDomain⟩ := refits α Γ dom domain
  obtain ⟨refitCodomain⟩ := refits α Γ cod ⟨codomain⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction codomain
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction refitDomain refitCodomain)⟩

theorem exact_InstalledApplicationTypeGuards : ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg Q
    calibration functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates V TV M M0 B T base s cv TV root other
    body α Γ qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn functionReport functionAccepted
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates V TV M M0 B T base s cv TV root other
    body α Γ qa ctx dom arg argumentReport argumentAccepted
  have arrow : Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight f)
  have domain : Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft (Derivation.conjunctionRight a)
  obtain ⟨guards⟩ := calibration α Γ dom cod ⟨arrow⟩ ⟨domain⟩
  exact ⟨⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction domain (Derivation.conjunctionLeft guards)⟩,
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight guards⟩⟩

theorem exact_InstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress :
    ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    calibration functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨syn,ty⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationTypeGuards V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other
    body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg calibration functionReport argumentReport
    functionAccepted argumentAccepted
  exact exact_InstalledSyntaxGuardedApplicationOutputAddress V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other
    body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal syn ty functionReport argumentReport
    functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish

theorem exact_InstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance :
    ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other body α Γ qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg goal Q
    calibration functionReport argumentReport functionAccepted argumentAccepted finish
  obtain ⟨syn,ty⟩ := exact_InstalledApplicationTypeGuards V TV M M0 B T base s cv root other

def GuardedAt (baseV baseM : Program 1) (P : Program 2) (G : Program 3) : Prop :=
  let V := syntaxFlag baseV
  let M := selectedMeasure (measureUpdate baseM P)
  let C := factoredCover V M G
  ∀ (entries : Entries) (s : Settings) (W : List ProbeTy), ValidWindow s W →
    HeadPairsSymmetric s.equivalentHeads → WindowSeedsCovered s →
    ∃ (i j cv tv : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (intrinsicBase : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (d oldCore oldLeast root other : Program 3) (v : Inputs),
      ActualRoot (NumberedWindowConcreteCheckers.root entries s) root ∧ ActualFallback other ∧
      ActualTermExchange s base ∧ IntrinsicWindowCalibrated s intrinsicBase ∧ TypeGuardCalibrated s T ∧
      let baseW := intrinsicQuery (selectedIntrinsic (windowUpdate intrinsicBase T))
      ActualPackedWindow s baseW ∧ AuxWindowAt baseW T ∧
      let Wp := window C s baseW V
      let X := measuredFactoredExchange s base V baseM P G
      let raw := typedRaw5 root other Wp V
      let least := packedLeastProgram C X Wp s
      let newI := addressScalar cv tv Wp least
      let final := frontendInputs newI least v

open NumberedWindowAddressProgramProof (validType)

private theorem guardNotOutside (s : Settings) : Primrec (typeGuard s) := by
  have contains : Primrec₂ (List.contains (α := Nat)) := by
    have has : PrimrecRel (fun (xs : List Nat) (n : Nat) => n ∈ xs) :=
      (Primrec.eq : PrimrecRel (Eq : Nat → Nat → Prop)).exists_mem_list.of_eq (by simp)
    apply has.decide.to₂.of_eq
    intro xs n
    apply Bool.eq_iff_iff.mpr
    simp
  exact Primrec.and.comp validType (contains.comp (Primrec.const s.window.1) Primrec.id)

private theorem intrinsicPrimitive (s : Settings) (W : Program 3)
    (window : NumberedWindowInternalSparseTypedRawTargets.ActualPackedWindow s W) :
    Primrec (fun v : List.Vector Nat 2 => intrinsicWindow s v.head v.tail.head) := by
  let V := List.Vector Nat 2
  have ctx : Primrec (fun v : V => v.head) := Primrec.vector_head
  have raw : Primrec (fun v : V => v.tail.head) := Primrec.vector_head.comp Primrec.vector_tail
  have ty : Primrec (fun v : V => intrinsicType v.tail.head) :=
    (Primrec.fst.comp annotationPrim).comp raw
  have tape := Primrec.vector_cons.comp ctx
    (Primrec.vector_cons.comp ty (Primrec.vector_cons.comp raw (Primrec.const List.Vector.nil)))
  have actual := (Proof.primitiveEvaluation 3 W).comp tape
  apply (Primrec.ite (Primrec.eq.comp actual (Primrec.const 1))
    (Primrec.succ.comp ty) (Primrec.const 0)).of_eq
  intro v
  change (if evaluate W (v.head ::ᵥ intrinsicType v.tail.head ::ᵥ v.tail.head ::ᵥ nil) = 1
    then intrinsicType v.tail.head + 1 else 0) = _
  rw [window]
  cases read : packedWindow s v.head (intrinsicType v.tail.head) v.tail.head <;>
    simp [intrinsicWindow,read]

theorem exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves : ExactWindowPrimitiveLeaves := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨W,window⟩ := packedWindowWitness s
  obtain ⟨base,evalBase⟩ := Proof.allPrimitiveFunctions 2 _ (intrinsicPrimitive s W window)
  have h : Primrec (fun n => (typeGuard s n).toNat) := by
    apply (Primrec.cond (guardNotOutside s) (Primrec.const 1) (Primrec.const 0)).of_eq
    intro n
    cases typeGuard s n <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨T,evalT⟩ := (Proof.unaryCorrespondence _).mp h
  exact ⟨base,T,fun ctx raw => evalBase (ctx ::ᵥ raw ::ᵥ nil),evalT⟩

#print axioms exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepPrograms

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowAnnotationAlgorithm

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm
open NumberedWindowAnnotationAlgorithm (annotations arrow)
open NumberedWindowPairAlgorithm (decode)
open NumberedWindowFieldAlgorithm (unpackNode)

abbrev Window := List Nat × List Nat
abbrev Row := Bool × Bool

def termParts (w : Window) (prev : List Row) (tag : Nat) (fs : List Nat) : Bool :=
  let val (i : Nat) := fs.getD i 0
  let ty (i : Nat) := w.1.contains (val i)
  let hd (i : Nat) := w.2.contains (val i)
  let tm (i : Nat) := (prev.getD (val i) (false,false)).1
  let ar (i : Nat) := (prev.getD (val i) (false,false)).2
  match tag with
  | 0 | 1 | 3 => ty 0
  | 2 => w.1.contains (arrow (val 0) (annotations (val 1)).1) && ty 0 && tm 1
  | 4 => hd 0 && ar 1
  | 5 => hd 0 && ty 1 && ar 3 && ar 4
  | 6 => ty 1 && ty 0 && tm 2 && tm 3
  | _ => false

def termNext (w : Window) (n : Nat) (prev : List Row) : Bool :=
  (unpackNode n).any (fun p => termParts w prev p.1 p.2)

def argsNext : Nat → List Row → Bool
  | 0, _ => true
  | n+1, prev => (decode n).any (fun p =>
    (prev.getD p.1 (false,false)).1 && (prev.getD p.2 (false,false)).2)

def table (w : Window) : Nat → List Row
  | 0 => []
  | n+1 => let prev := table w n; prev ++ [(termNext w n prev, argsNext n prev)]

def rawBits (w : Window) (n : Nat) : Row :=
  (termNext w n (table w n), argsNext n (table w n))

def bits (w : Window) (n : Nat) : Row :=
  let valid := NumberedWindowSyntaxAlgorithm.syntaxBits n
  let result := rawBits w n
  (valid.1 && result.1, valid.2 && result.2)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm

## G05 — calibration of the type guards

### Plan

Task: (1) does `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entail the refit guard at `ty`; (2) `ArrowCodomainInversion`
for the actual calibrated type program at a `Settings` with closed type list; (3) the #1453 statements
with no premise beyond that closure.

What was read: this ledger's G04 section, `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`, the two `…GuardFree…` modules,
`NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.lean` (48 lines), `NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepPrograms.lean`
lines 20–65, the three general-`tv` application targets of #1438/#1440/#1442, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. **The window does not test the guard at an operand's own type.** `Q.window =
   thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V` = `conjunction (conjunction P.W (V∘proj 2)) (conjunction
   thinContextPresent (thinOwnSeed …))`, and `P.W` bottoms out in `strictAuxWindow base (refitGuard s T)
   = intrinsicQuery (strictAuxIntrinsic base (refitGuard s T))`. `intrinsicQuery F` is the equality test
   `F(ctx, k) = succ ty`. The guard program occurs in exactly one place, `admittedChildren` inside
   `strictAuxPositive` (`NumberedWindowInternalStrictAuxWindowTargets.lean:26`,
   `…AuxWindowStepTargets.lean:31`): at a key of auxiliary shape it is applied to the key's fields 0 and
   1 (`dom`, `cod`). At every other key the row is the base callback's value. So for an open `k` the
   formula `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` contains no occurrence of the guard at `ty`; an entailment would
   need an internal case analysis on the shape of `k` plus a separate "types of windowed terms are
   guarded" lemma per shape. Grep found the forward rule only (`ExactOpenAuxWindow`: guards ⟹ window)
   and `ExactOpenCoverNumberedTypeWindow` (numbered key ⟹ grammar membership of the stored annotation,
   not of `T`, and not of the window's own `ty` in general). Numerically the same picture:
   `NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.termParts` checks `w.1.contains` on the own type for tags 0, 1, 3,
   on the arrow for tag 2, on fields 1 and 0 for tags 5/6, and on **no type at all** for tag 4.
   Item 1 as posed is therefore answered NO; nothing is gated for it.
2. **The actual type programs carry numeric calibration only.** `exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves`
   (`…AuxWindowStepPrograms.lean:52`) obtains `T` from `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` applied to
   `Primrec (typeGuard s ·)`; `ConcreteAddressPositive` and `GuardedAt` give `tv`/`T` under `∃` with
   `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv [n] = (typeBit n).toNat` and `TypeGuardCalibrated s T : ∀ ty,
   run T ty = (typeGuard s ty).toNat`, `typeGuard s ty = typeBit ty && s.window.1.contains ty`. These are
   existentially chosen programs with an evaluation equation and no known AST; the repository's stated
   rule (`InternalAcceptanceTargets.lean:26`) is "Natural evaluation is calibration only, never reflected
   into Derivation". No object-calculus derivation for open `dom`, `cod` follows. Item 2 as posed is
   answered: only the numeric calibration exists.
3. **Closure is not a field of `Settings`.** `structure Settings` is `window : List Nat × List Nat`,
   `types : List Nat`, `equivalentHeads`. The repository's closure predicate is `ChildClosed W`
   (`…FreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets.lean:19`: `arrow σ τ ∈ W → τ ∈ W`, codomain only) on a separate
   `W : List ProbeTy`, tied to `s` by `TypeSupport s W` inside `ValidWindow s W`, whose docstring says
   "Numerical interface only … not used as a rule of the object theory". `GrammarTypeInclusion s` is
   `s.window.1 ⊆ s.types`, not a closure. No `SubtypeClosed`-style predicate on `s.types` exists.
4. **The #1453 premise is false in the standard model for the actual calibrations.** With `TV`
   calibrated to `typeBit` (all valid type codes, infinitely many) and `refitGuard s T` to `typeGuard s`
   plus membership in `s.types` (finite), `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T` reads "every valid type code is
   in the finite window list", and `TypeGuardArrowCalibration` fails the same way at any valid `dom`
   outside the window. This is an argument (it also needs soundness of the calculus), not a gated
   theorem. Consequence: the route "`TV` ⟹ refit guard" cannot be the calibration of the actual tuple.

What the accepted material does support (and what is gated here): the scalar's own type-checker slot
`tv` of `install` is a free parameter in the general statements of #1438/#1440/#1442. Installing
`tv := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)` makes scalar acceptance of the two operands supply BOTH type
programs at `rawCons dom cod` and at `dom` (`exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` + `conjunctionRecover`).
What remains is then exactly codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T` — the shrink item 1
asked for, reached through the scalar slot instead of the window. `SyntaxGuardRefits` disappears. The
refit inversion further splits (via `exact_OpenSettingsRefitGuardReports`) into inversion of `T` and
inversion of literal membership in `s.types`.

## G05 — calibration of the type guards

### Plan

Task: (1) does `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entail the refit guard at `ty`; (2) `ArrowCodomainInversion`
for the actual calibrated type program at a `Settings` with closed type list; (3) the #1453 statements
with no premise beyond that closure.

What was read: this ledger's G04 section, `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`, the two `…GuardFree…` modules,
`NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.lean` (48 lines), `NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepPrograms.lean`
lines 20–65, the three general-`tv` application targets of #1438/#1440/#1442, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. **The window does not test the guard at an operand's own type.** `Q.window =
   thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V` = `conjunction (conjunction P.W (V∘proj 2)) (conjunction
   thinContextPresent (thinOwnSeed …))`, and `P.W` bottoms out in `strictAuxWindow base (refitGuard s T)
   = intrinsicQuery (strictAuxIntrinsic base (refitGuard s T))`. `intrinsicQuery F` is the equality test
   `F(ctx, k) = succ ty`. The guard program occurs in exactly one place, `admittedChildren` inside
   `strictAuxPositive` (`NumberedWindowInternalStrictAuxWindowTargets.lean:26`,
   `…AuxWindowStepTargets.lean:31`): at a key of auxiliary shape it is applied to the key's fields 0 and
   1 (`dom`, `cod`). At every other key the row is the base callback's value. So for an open `k` the
   formula `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` contains no occurrence of the guard at `ty`; an entailment would
   need an internal case analysis on the shape of `k` plus a separate "types of windowed terms are
   guarded" lemma per shape. Grep found the forward rule only (`ExactOpenAuxWindow`: guards ⟹ window)
   and `ExactOpenCoverNumberedTypeWindow` (numbered key ⟹ grammar membership of the stored annotation,
   not of `T`, and not of the window's own `ty` in general). Numerically the same picture:
   `NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.termParts` checks `w.1.contains` on the own type for tags 0, 1, 3,
   on the arrow for tag 2, on fields 1 and 0 for tags 5/6, and on **no type at all** for tag 4.
   Item 1 as posed is therefore answered NO; nothing is gated for it.
2. **The actual type programs carry numeric calibration only.** `exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves`
   (`…AuxWindowStepPrograms.lean:52`) obtains `T` from `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` applied to
   `Primrec (typeGuard s ·)`; `ConcreteAddressPositive` and `GuardedAt` give `tv`/`T` under `∃` with
   `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv [n] = (typeBit n).toNat` and `TypeGuardCalibrated s T : ∀ ty,
   run T ty = (typeGuard s ty).toNat`, `typeGuard s ty = typeBit ty && s.window.1.contains ty`. These are
   existentially chosen programs with an evaluation equation and no known AST; the repository's stated
   rule (`InternalAcceptanceTargets.lean:26`) is "Natural evaluation is calibration only, never reflected
   into Derivation". No object-calculus derivation for open `dom`, `cod` follows. Item 2 as posed is
   answered: only the numeric calibration exists.
3. **Closure is not a field of `Settings`.** `structure Settings` is `window : List Nat × List Nat`,
   `types : List Nat`, `equivalentHeads`. The repository's closure predicate is `ChildClosed W`
   (`…FreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets.lean:19`: `arrow σ τ ∈ W → τ ∈ W`, codomain only) on a separate
   `W : List ProbeTy`, tied to `s` by `TypeSupport s W` inside `ValidWindow s W`, whose docstring says
   "Numerical interface only … not used as a rule of the object theory". `GrammarTypeInclusion s` is
   `s.window.1 ⊆ s.types`, not a closure. No `SubtypeClosed`-style predicate on `s.types` exists.
4. **The #1453 premise is false in the standard model for the actual calibrations.** With `TV`
   calibrated to `typeBit` (all valid type codes, infinitely many) and `refitGuard s T` to `typeGuard s`
   plus membership in `s.types` (finite), `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T` reads "every valid type code is
   in the finite window list", and `TypeGuardArrowCalibration` fails the same way at any valid `dom`
   outside the window. This is an argument (it also needs soundness of the calculus), not a gated
   theorem. Consequence: the route "`TV` ⟹ refit guard" cannot be the calibration of the actual tuple.

What the accepted material does support (and what is attempted here): the scalar's own type-checker
slot `tv` of `install` is a free parameter in the general statements of #1438/#1440/#1442. Installing
`tv := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)` makes scalar acceptance of the two operands supply BOTH type
programs at `rawCons dom cod` and at `dom` (`exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` + `conjunctionRecover`).
What remains is then exactly codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T` — the shrink item 1
asked for, reached through the scalar slot instead of the window. `SyntaxGuardRefits` disappears. The
refit inversion further splits (via `exact_OpenSettingsRefitGuardReports`) into inversion of `T` and
inversion of literal membership in `s.types`.

# Fable-2 ledger — local round 3 (2026-11-22)

## G04 — type guards

### Plan

Discharge the two retained type-guard conjunctions of #1438/#1440/#1442 at `tv := TV`:
`unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod` and
`unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod`.

What was read (and only this): the three `…Targets.lean` of #1438/#1440/#1442, the #1438 proof,
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall{Definitions,Targets,Proof}.lean`, review findings 1
and 2 of `github-round2-review-2026-11-22/P16-APPLICATION-REVIEW.md`, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` returns, from `addressReport q ctx ty k` and
   `unary Q.scalar (suc z) q`: `unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓ (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
   leastGraph … ctx ty k k))`. At `tv := TV` the two operands therefore supply
   `unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` (from `qf`) and `unary TV (suc z) dom` (from `qa`). So the
   first component of the syntax guard is free; nothing else of the two conjunctions is.
2. `TV` and `T` are universally quantified `Program 1` parameters of `install` with NO calibration
   hypothesis in any of the three statements. `refitGuard s T = conjunction T (grammarTypeAt s)`
   (`NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions.lean:30`), i.e. `T` plus physical membership
   in the finite list `s.types`.
3. Grep for an accepted arrow-inversion law (`ArrowInversion`, `TypeInversion`, `arrowInversion`,
   `typeGood`, `ArrowClosed`, and any target whose conclusion is `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) _`) in
   `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/*Targets.lean`: no match. The only calibrations of type programs
   found (`TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualTypeGuard tv`) are numeric evaluation statements, not
   derivability laws of the internal calculus, and none is a hypothesis of the application statements.
4. Hence branch three of the task: arrow inversion is not available for arbitrary `TV`/`T` (a `TV`
   accepting the single code `rawCons a b` and nothing else is a legitimate `Program 1`), so the guards
   are derived under a NAMED calibration premise and the guard-free statements are proved under exactly
   that premise.

Premise chosen: `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T` — for all `α Γ dom cod`, from derivations of
`unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` and `unary TV (suc z) dom` a derivation of
`unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)`.
Hypotheses = exactly what scalar acceptance supplies; conclusion = exactly what is missing. Two
component laws (`ArrowCodomainInversion body TV`, `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T`) are stated and shown
sufficient, so the premise has a readable decomposition.

Not attempted (budget): whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` already entails the refit guard at `ty`
(the base window is `numberedTypeWindow … T`, which may check `T`); if it does, the refit half at `dom`
would be free and the premise could shrink to codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T`.

### Targets + sha256 (recorded before the proof module was drafted)

`LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets.lean`
sha256 `59d05ab1d9b4bd5d972fb66199122a27e20447cba68a9af4bb19031d1940005d`

Definitions: `ArrowCodomainInversion`, `SyntaxGuardRefits`, `TypeGuardArrowCalibration`.
Statements: `ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents`, `ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress`, `ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.

### Receipts

- `1795402283407171155-3276597` (`build-reports/1795402283407171155-3276597.json`, sha256
  `54f38d0db2b2ea0c9198827838f394b8e6bf2089a6eb18c3e4d413da4851cee8`) — `gate.sh mathlib` on
  `…GuardFreeTargets` and `…GuardFreeProof`: COMPILE_PASS for both. Five `#print axioms` lines, each
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- Proof module sha256 `638cbda693b86d63cf92d63c387c204467be91c4c0f195e4cb2ba750af245ccb`; targets
  sha256 unchanged from the frozen value above.

### Failures

None. One gate run, passed first time. (A plain multi-file read command was refused by the
permission mode early on; files were read with the read tool instead — no effect on the work.)

### State and next

STOPPED AT FIRST GATED STATEMENT. Result is conditional: the guards are discharged under the named
premise `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T`, not unconditionally. Evidence in
`TYPE-GUARDS-EVIDENCE.json`, claims and non-claims in `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

Next, in order:
1. Read `numberedTypeWindow` / `headFittedWindow` to see whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entails
   `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) ty`. If yes, the refit guard at `dom` and at `rawCons dom cod` comes
   free from the operands' windows and the premise shrinks to codomain inversion of `TV` and of
   `refitGuard s T`.
2. Prove `ArrowCodomainInversion` for the actual source type program (the one calibrated by
   `ActualTypeGuard` / `TypeGuardCalibrated`), which needs an internal inversion of that program and
   closure of `s.types` under arrow components (`GrammarTypeInclusion s` is the place to look).

    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ

    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),

        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)

      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ

input. It is a different program from `TV`; an installation using it accepts
an address only if its reported type also passes the refit guard. -/
def refittedScalarType (s : Settings) (TV T : Program 1) : Program 1 :=
  conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)

/-- Codomain inversion of physical membership in the literal grammar type
list of `s`, as a rule of the calculus over `body`: membership of
`rawCons dom cod` yields membership of `cod`. Its numeric shadow is closure of
the finite list `s.types` under arrow codomains; this definition is the
internal rule, not that numeric fact, and no implication from the numeric fact
to this rule is claimed. -/
def GrammarCodomainInversion (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (dom cod : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (memberGraph (numeral (Encodable.encode s.types)) (rawCons dom cod))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph (numeral (Encodable.encode s.types)) cod))

/-- Codomain inversion of the refit guard follows from codomain inversion of
its two conjuncts: the supplied `T` and literal grammar-type membership. -/
def ExactRefitGuardCodomainInversionFromComponents : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (s : Settings) (T : Program 1),
    ArrowCodomainInversion body T → GrammarCodomainInversion body s →
    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T)

/-- All three type facts the general application statements require, derived
for the installation whose scalar type checker is `refittedScalarType s TV T`.
Two accepted operand addresses with matching function/argument reports at one
context yield, under codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T` and
nothing else about the type programs, the syntax guards at `dom` and `cod`,
the refit guards at `dom` and `cod`, and the scalar's own type checker at
`cod`. No rule from `TV` to the refit guard is a premise. -/
def ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationTypeGuards : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) root other
    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV →
    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) ∧
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refittedScalarType s TV T) (suc z) cod))

/-- The accepted output address of an application for the refitted
installation, with no type-guard hypothesis: under codomain inversion of `TV`
and of `refitGuard s T`, two accepted installed-scalar operand addresses with
their original reports at one context yield, under the genuine object
continuation, the measured least `m` of the actual auxiliary term, the
original report of `addressTerm ctx cod m`, and its acceptance by the same
installed scalar. -/
def ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationOutputAddress : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) root other
    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV →
    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- Frontend acceptance for the refitted installation, with no type-guard
hypothesis: the same premises, and the continuation additionally receives the
unit graph of the actual installed application program on
`(qf, qa, addressTerm ctx cod m)`. -/
def ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) root other
    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV →
    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (programGraph Q.application (suc z)
          ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m])) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

/-- Output functionality for the refitted installation, with no type-guard
hypothesis: the same premises, and the continuation additionally receives, for
every term `y` of the extended context, the internal implication from
acceptance of `(qf, qa, y)` by the installed application program to
`y = addressTerm ctx cod m`. -/
def ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2)
    (s : Settings) (cv : Program 1) (root other : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (qf qa ctx dom cod fn arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) root other
    ArrowCodomainInversion body TV →
    ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (addressReport qa ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (m : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph Q.source.cover Q.exchange Q.window s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
          ((auxiliaryTerm dom cod fn arg).relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (addressReport (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)
          (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (unary Q.scalar (suc z) (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (programGraph Q.application (suc z)
          ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m])) →
      (∀ y : OTerm β, Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        ((programGraph Q.application (suc z) ![qf.relabel j,qa.relabel j,y]).imp
          (eqn y (addressTerm (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) m))))) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

# Fable-2 ledger — local round 3 (2026-11-22)

## G04 — type guards

### Plan

Discharge the two retained type-guard conjunctions of #1438/#1440/#1442 at `tv := TV`:
`unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod` and
`unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod`.

What was read (and only this): the three `…Targets.lean` of #1438/#1440/#1442, the #1438 proof,
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall{Definitions,Targets,Proof}.lean`, review findings 1
and 2 of `github-round2-review-2026-11-22/P16-APPLICATION-REVIEW.md`, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` returns, from `addressReport q ctx ty k` and
   `unary Q.scalar (suc z) q`: `unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓ (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
   leastGraph … ctx ty k k))`. At `tv := TV` the two operands therefore supply
   `unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` (from `qf`) and `unary TV (suc z) dom` (from `qa`). So the
   first component of the syntax guard is free; nothing else of the two conjunctions is.
2. `TV` and `T` are universally quantified `Program 1` parameters of `install` with NO calibration
   hypothesis in any of the three statements. `refitGuard s T = conjunction T (grammarTypeAt s)`
   (`NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions.lean:30`), i.e. `T` plus physical membership
   in the finite list `s.types`.
3. Grep for an accepted arrow-inversion law (`ArrowInversion`, `TypeInversion`, `arrowInversion`,
   `typeGood`, `ArrowClosed`, and any target whose conclusion is `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) _`) in
   `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/*Targets.lean`: no match. The only calibrations of type programs
   found (`TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualTypeGuard tv`) are numeric evaluation statements, not
   derivability laws of the internal calculus, and none is a hypothesis of the application statements.
4. Hence branch three of the task: arrow inversion is not available for arbitrary `TV`/`T` (a `TV`
   accepting the single code `rawCons a b` and nothing else is a legitimate `Program 1`), so the guards
   are derived under a NAMED calibration premise and the guard-free statements are proved under exactly
   that premise.

Premise chosen: `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T` — for all `α Γ dom cod`, from derivations of
`unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` and `unary TV (suc z) dom` a derivation of
`unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)`.
Hypotheses = exactly what scalar acceptance supplies; conclusion = exactly what is missing. Two
component laws (`ArrowCodomainInversion body TV`, `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T`) are stated and shown
sufficient, so the premise has a readable decomposition.

Not attempted (budget): whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` already entails the refit guard at `ty`
(the base window is `numberedTypeWindow … T`, which may check `T`); if it does, the refit half at `dom`
would be free and the premise could shrink to codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T`.

### Targets + sha256 (recorded before the proof module was drafted)

`LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationGuardFreeTargets.lean`
sha256 `59d05ab1d9b4bd5d972fb66199122a27e20447cba68a9af4bb19031d1940005d`

Definitions: `ArrowCodomainInversion`, `SyntaxGuardRefits`, `TypeGuardArrowCalibration`.
Statements: `ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents`, `ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress`, `ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.

### Receipts

- `1795402283407171155-3276597` (`build-reports/1795402283407171155-3276597.json`, sha256
  `54f38d0db2b2ea0c9198827838f394b8e6bf2089a6eb18c3e4d413da4851cee8`) — `gate.sh mathlib` on
  `…GuardFreeTargets` and `…GuardFreeProof`: COMPILE_PASS for both. Five `#print axioms` lines, each
  `[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.
- Proof module sha256 `638cbda693b86d63cf92d63c387c204467be91c4c0f195e4cb2ba750af245ccb`; targets
  sha256 unchanged from the frozen value above.

### Failures

None. One gate run, passed first time. (A plain multi-file read command was refused by the
permission mode early on; files were read with the read tool instead — no effect on the work.)

### State and next

STOPPED AT FIRST GATED STATEMENT. Result is conditional: the guards are discharged under the named
premise `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T`, not unconditionally. Evidence in
`TYPE-GUARDS-EVIDENCE.json`, claims and non-claims in `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`.

Next, in order:
1. Read `numberedTypeWindow` / `headFittedWindow` to see whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entails
   `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) ty`. If yes, the refit guard at `dom` and at `rawCons dom cod` comes
   free from the operands' windows and the premise shrinks to codomain inversion of `TV` and of
   `refitGuard s T`.
2. Prove `ArrowCodomainInversion` for the actual source type program (the one calibrated by
   `ActualTypeGuard` / `TypeGuardCalibrated`), which needs an internal inversion of that program and
   closure of `s.types` under arrow components (`GrammarTypeInclusion s` is the place to look).

## G05 — calibration of the type guards

### Plan

Task: (1) does `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` entail the refit guard at `ty`; (2) `ArrowCodomainInversion`
for the actual calibrated type program at a `Settings` with closed type list; (3) the #1453 statements
with no premise beyond that closure.

What was read: this ledger's G04 section, `TYPE-GUARDS-SOURCE-MAP.md`, the two `…GuardFree…` modules,
`NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.lean` (48 lines), `NumberedWindowInternalAuxWindowStepPrograms.lean`
lines 20–65, the three general-`tv` application targets of #1438/#1440/#1442, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. **The window does not test the guard at an operand's own type.** `Q.window =
   thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V` = `conjunction (conjunction P.W (V∘proj 2)) (conjunction
   thinContextPresent (thinOwnSeed …))`, and `P.W` bottoms out in `strictAuxWindow base (refitGuard s T)
   = intrinsicQuery (strictAuxIntrinsic base (refitGuard s T))`. `intrinsicQuery F` is the equality test
   `F(ctx, k) = succ ty`. The guard program occurs in exactly one place, `admittedChildren` inside
   `strictAuxPositive` (`NumberedWindowInternalStrictAuxWindowTargets.lean:26`,
   `…AuxWindowStepTargets.lean:31`): at a key of auxiliary shape it is applied to the key's fields 0 and
   1 (`dom`, `cod`). At every other key the row is the base callback's value. So for an open `k` the
   formula `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` contains no occurrence of the guard at `ty`; an entailment would
   need an internal case analysis on the shape of `k` plus a separate "types of windowed terms are
   guarded" lemma per shape. Grep found the forward rule only (`ExactOpenAuxWindow`: guards ⟹ window)
   and `ExactOpenCoverNumberedTypeWindow` (numbered key ⟹ grammar membership of the stored annotation,
   not of `T`, and not of the window's own `ty` in general). Numerically the same picture:
   `NumberedWindowAdmissionAlgorithm.termParts` checks `w.1.contains` on the own type for tags 0, 1, 3,
   on the arrow for tag 2, on fields 1 and 0 for tags 5/6, and on **no type at all** for tag 4.
   Item 1 as posed is therefore answered NO; nothing is gated for it.
2. **The actual type programs carry numeric calibration only.** `exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves`
   (`…AuxWindowStepPrograms.lean:52`) obtains `T` from `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` applied to
   `Primrec (typeGuard s ·)`; `ConcreteAddressPositive` and `GuardedAt` give `tv`/`T` under `∃` with
   `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv [n] = (typeBit n).toNat` and `TypeGuardCalibrated s T : ∀ ty,
   run T ty = (typeGuard s ty).toNat`, `typeGuard s ty = typeBit ty && s.window.1.contains ty`. These are
   existentially chosen programs with an evaluation equation and no known AST; the repository's stated
   rule (`InternalAcceptanceTargets.lean:26`) is "Natural evaluation is calibration only, never reflected
   into Derivation". No object-calculus derivation for open `dom`, `cod` follows. Item 2 as posed is
   answered: only the numeric calibration exists.
3. **Closure is not a field of `Settings`.** `structure Settings` is `window : List Nat × List Nat`,
   `types : List Nat`, `equivalentHeads`. The repository's closure predicate is `ChildClosed W`
   (`…FreshProbeDispatchWindowTargets.lean:19`: `arrow σ τ ∈ W → τ ∈ W`, codomain only) on a separate
   `W : List ProbeTy`, tied to `s` by `TypeSupport s W` inside `ValidWindow s W`, whose docstring says
   "Numerical interface only … not used as a rule of the object theory". `GrammarTypeInclusion s` is
   `s.window.1 ⊆ s.types`, not a closure. No `SubtypeClosed`-style predicate on `s.types` exists.
4. **The #1453 premise is false in the standard model for the actual calibrations.** With `TV`
   calibrated to `typeBit` (all valid type codes, infinitely many) and `refitGuard s T` to `typeGuard s`
   plus membership in `s.types` (finite), `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T` reads "every valid type code is
   in the finite window list", and `TypeGuardArrowCalibration` fails the same way at any valid `dom`
   outside the window. This is an argument (it also needs soundness of the calculus), not a gated
   theorem. Consequence: the route "`TV` ⟹ refit guard" cannot be the calibration of the actual tuple.

What the accepted material does support (and what is attempted here): the scalar's own type-checker
slot `tv` of `install` is a free parameter in the general statements of #1438/#1440/#1442. Installing
`tv := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)` makes scalar acceptance of the two operands supply BOTH type
programs at `rawCons dom cod` and at `dom` (`exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` + `conjunctionRecover`).
What remains is then exactly codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T` — the shrink item 1
asked for, reached through the scalar slot instead of the window. `SyntaxGuardRefits` disappears. The
refit inversion further splits (via `exact_OpenSettingsRefitGuardReports`) into inversion of `T` and
inversion of literal membership in `s.types`.

# G05 — calibration of the type guards: source map

Modules (both new, in `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/`):
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationTypeCalibrationTargets.lean` and
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverMeasuredApplicationTypeCalibrationProof.lean`.
Passing receipt `1795402855547066197-3279443`. Hashes and `#print axioms` lines are in
`TYPE-CALIBRATION-EVIDENCE.json`.

## Outcome in one paragraph

Neither of the two things the task hoped for is available from the accepted material: the installed
window does **not** entail the refit guard at an operand's own type, and the actual type programs have
**only numeric** calibration, so `ArrowCodomainInversion` cannot be proved for them. What is gated is
the premise shrink by a different, supported route: install the scalar with type checker
`conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)`. Then operand acceptance supplies both type programs at the arrow
and at the domain, and the three application statements hold under codomain inversion of `TV` and of
`refitGuard s T` only. This is a statement about a different installed tuple than #1453.

## Claimed

Throughout, `Q := install s V TV M M0 B T base cv (refittedScalarType s TV T) root other`, with
`refittedScalarType s TV T := conjunction TV (refitGuard s T)`.

1. `exact_RefittedInstalledApplicationTypeGuards : ExactRefittedInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`.
   Given `ArrowCodomainInversion body TV`, `ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T)`,
   `addressReport qf ctx (rawCons dom cod) fn`, `addressReport qa ctx dom arg`,
   `unary Q.scalar (suc z) qf` and `unary Q.scalar (suc z) qa` (all derivable from `Γ`), the following
   are derivable from `Γ`: `unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod`;
   `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod`; and
   `unary (refittedScalarType s TV T) (suc z) cod`.
   Proof: `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` at `tv := refittedScalarType s TV T` for each operand,
   `conjunctionRecover` to split the scalar's type fact into its `TV` and refit halves, the two
   inversions at `rawCons dom cod`, `conjunctionAccept` to rebuild the scalar's type fact at `cod`.
2. `exact_RefittedInstalledApplicationOutputAddress`,
   `exact_RefittedInstalledApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
   `exact_RefittedInstalledApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.
   The general-`tv` statements of #1438, #1440 and #1442 at `tv := refittedScalarType s TV T`, with all
   three type-guard hypotheses removed and the two inversion premises added. Continuation and
   conclusions are textually those of the general statements (measured least `m`, report and scalar
   acceptance of `addressTerm ctx cod m`, unit graph of `Q.application`, and for every `y` the
   implication from application acceptance of `(qf, qa, y)` to `y = addressTerm ctx cod m`). Each is
   item 1 followed by the existing gated general theorem; no existing proof was re-done.
3. `exact_RefitGuardCodomainInversionFromComponents`.
   `ArrowCodomainInversion body T` together with `GrammarCodomainInversion body s` imply
   `ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T)`. Unconditional; uses
   `exact_OpenSettingsRefitGuardReports` in both directions.

## Assumed (explicit)

- `ArrowCodomainInversion body TV` and `ArrowCodomainInversion body (refitGuard s T)` (definition from
  the G04 targets): for all `α Γ dom cod`, a derivation of the program at `rawCons dom cod` from `Γ`
  yields a derivation of it at `cod`. Rules over derivations at one `body`, quantified over every
  context; used only at the statement's own `α`, `Γ`, `dom`, `cod`.
- For item 3 only: `GrammarCodomainInversion body s`, the same rule for
  `memberGraph (numeral (Encodable.encode s.types)) ·`.
- The two operand reports at one shared `ctx` and the two scalar acceptances, as before.
- **Status of these premises.** In the standard model each is true exactly when the corresponding
  finite datum is closed under arrow codomains (`s.window.1` for a `T` calibrated to `typeGuard s`,
  `s.types` for the grammar half; `typeBit` is closed outright). So their numeric shadows are finite,
  checkable properties of the settings. As stated — rules of the object calculus for open `dom`, `cod`
  — they are **open internal statements**: no accepted theorem turns the numeric fact into the rule.

## Not claimed

- **Item 1 of the task: the window does not entail the refit guard at its type.** In
  `Q.window = thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V`, the only occurrence of the guard program is in
  `admittedChildren` (`strictAuxPositive`), applied to fields 0 and 1 of a key of auxiliary shape;
  `intrinsicQuery` itself is the equality `F(ctx, k) = succ ty`. The accepted open rules go the other
  way (`ExactOpenAuxWindow`: guards ⟹ window) or give grammar membership of a numbered key's stored
  annotation (`ExactOpenCoverNumberedTypeWindow`). This is a reading of the definitions, **not** a
  gated non-derivability theorem.
- **Item 2 of the task: no `ArrowCodomainInversion` for the actual type program.** The calibrations
  that exist are `ActualTypeGuard tv : ∀ n, evaluate tv (n ::ᵥ nil) = (typeBit n).toNat` and
  `TypeGuardCalibrated s T : ∀ ty, run T ty = (typeGuard s ty).toNat`, and the programs are obtained
  under `∃` from `Proof.unaryCorrespondence` on a `Primrec` proof (`exact_WindowPrimitiveLeaves`). The
  internal statement that would be needed, for a **named** program `P` rather than an existential
  witness: for every `body α Γ dom cod`, `Γ ⊢ unary P (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` ⟹
  `Γ ⊢ unary P (suc z) cod`. For the grammar half this is a finite case analysis on the literal list
  `s.types` (needs: an elimination rule for `memberGraph` at a numeral list, injectivity of `rawCons`
  against numerals, and numeric closure of `s.types`); for `typeBit` it needs a concrete
  course-of-values program and its internal unfolding at a successor-of-pair code.
- **No closure hypothesis on `Settings` is introduced or used.** `Settings` has no closure field;
  the repository's predicate is `ChildClosed W` on a separate `W : List ProbeTy` linked by
  `TypeSupport s W` in `ValidWindow s W`, documented as "Numerical interface only … not used as a rule
  of the object theory". I did not add a numeric closure definition because no gated statement here
  could consume it.
- **Item 3 of the task is not reached.**
- **Nothing about the `tv := TV` installation of #1453.** Its premise `TypeGuardArrowCalibration`
  (through `SyntaxGuardRefits`) reads, under the actual calibrations, "every valid type code lies in
  the finite window list" and is false in the standard model. That is an argument, not a gated
  theorem; it also relies on soundness of the calculus, which I did not look up.
- **The refitted scalar is not shown to be an accepted installation.** `refittedScalarType s TV T` does
  not satisfy `ActualTypeGuard` (numerically it is `typeGuard s` plus membership in `s.types`, narrower
  than `typeBit`). Whether `ConcreteAddressPositive` / `GuardedAt` and everything downstream of
  `ActualTypeGuard tv` survive this choice was not examined. Until it is, the gated statements describe
  a well-defined installed tuple whose numeric acceptance of the paper's addresses is unverified.
- All remaining boundaries of the round-2 review stand: output witness under the object continuation
  only, functionality as a schema over terms, one shared context, no numbered Paper 16 statement closed.

# Fable-2 ledger — local round 3 (2026-11-22)

## G04 — type guards

### Plan

Discharge the two retained type-guard conjunctions of #1438/#1440/#1442 at `tv := TV`:
`unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod` and
`unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod`.

What was read (and only this): the three `…Targets.lean` of #1438/#1440/#1442, the #1438 proof,
`NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedMeasuredInstall{Definitions,Targets,Proof}.lean`, review findings 1
and 2 of `github-round2-review-2026-11-22/P16-APPLICATION-REVIEW.md`, and greps for definitions.

Diagnosis before any target was written:

1. `exact_InstalledCarrierCoordinates` returns, from `addressReport q ctx ty k` and
   `unary Q.scalar (suc z) q`: `unary cv (suc z) ctx ⊓ (unary tv (suc z) ty ⊓ (windowAt Q.window ctx ty k ⊓
   leastGraph … ctx ty k k))`. At `tv := TV` the two operands therefore supply
   `unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` (from `qf`) and `unary TV (suc z) dom` (from `qa`). So the
   first component of the syntax guard is free; nothing else of the two conjunctions is.
2. `TV` and `T` are universally quantified `Program 1` parameters of `install` with NO calibration
   hypothesis in any of the three statements. `refitGuard s T = conjunction T (grammarTypeAt s)`
   (`NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions.lean:30`), i.e. `T` plus physical membership
   in the finite list `s.types`.
3. Grep for an accepted arrow-inversion law (`ArrowInversion`, `TypeInversion`, `arrowInversion`,
   `typeGood`, `ArrowClosed`, and any target whose conclusion is `unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) _`) in
   `LogicLineages/PersistentMarking/*Targets.lean`: no match. The only calibrations of type programs
   found (`TypeGuardCalibrated s T`, `ActualTypeGuard tv`) are numeric evaluation statements, not
   derivability laws of the internal calculus, and none is a hypothesis of the application statements.
4. Hence branch three of the task: arrow inversion is not available for arbitrary `TV`/`T` (a `TV`
   accepting the single code `rawCons a b` and nothing else is a legitimate `Program 1`), so the guards
   are derived under a NAMED calibration premise and the guard-free statements are proved under exactly
   that premise.

Premise chosen: `TypeGuardArrowCalibration body s TV T` — for all `α Γ dom cod`, from derivations of
`unary TV (suc z) (rawCons dom cod)` and `unary TV (suc z) dom` a derivation of
`unary TV (suc z) cod ⊓ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)`.
Hypotheses = exactly what scalar acceptance supplies; conclusion = exactly what is missing. Two
component laws (`ArrowCodomainInversion body TV`, `SyntaxGuardRefits body s TV T`) are stated and shown
sufficient, so the premise has a readable decomposition.

Not attempted (budget): whether `windowAt Q.window ctx ty k` already entails the refit guard at `ty`
(the base window is `numberedTypeWindow … T`, which may check `T`); if it does, the refit half at `dom`
would be free and the premise could shrink to codomain inversion of `TV` and of `refitGuard s T`.

### Targets + sha256 (recorded before the proof module was drafted)

Statements: `ExactTypeGuardArrowCalibrationFromComponents`, `ExactInstalledApplicationTypeGuards`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputAddress`, `ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationFrontendAcceptance`,
`ExactInstalledGuardFreeApplicationOutputFunctionalityContinuation`.

- Proof module sha256 `638cbda693b86d63cf92d63c387c204467be91c4c0f195e4cb2ba750af245ccb`; targets

permission mode early on; files were read with the read tool instead — no effect on the work.)
